_doc: 公告数据 — 客户端「公告」面板 (public/js/ui/notice.js). Shape: { "title": "服务器公告", "sections": [ { "label": "小节名", "lines": [ ... ] } ], "updatedAt": "2026-10-05" }. Sections render in order as 「小号暗色标签行 + 下面的内容行」. Each `lines` entry is one of: (1) a PLAIN-TEXT string — the original form; (2) { "segments": [ { "t": "文本" }, { "t": "裸链接文字", "href": "https://…" } ] } — structured text, NEVER markup: the client parses no tags and builds no HTML, each segment becomes a text node and a segment with an href becomes an <a>; (3) { "spacer": true } — a blank line inside a section. 链接文字只写要显示的内容本身（站点名或裸域名），不要写括号（（）()「」），也不要塞说明性文字。 An `href` is rendered ONLY when it is https: on one of space.bilibili.com / ai.xiaolubao.com / wpa.qq.com / github.com, or a mailto: address — javascript:, data:, http:, //host and every other host silently render as plain text. 旧的扁平结构 { "title", "body": [ ... ] }（元素与 lines 相同）仍然兼容，会渲染成一个无标签的节。 有意省略的两节：联系邮箱、GitHub 仓库 — 用户没有提供值，所以这里既没有占位符也没有编造的内容；以后要加，只需在本文件 sections 里追加一节：邮箱节 label 写「联系邮箱」，lines 里放一个段 { "t": 邮箱地址, "href": "mailto:邮箱地址" }；仓库节 label 写「GitHub」，lines 里放一个段 { "t": github.com 上的裸路径, "href": "https://github.com/同一路径" } — github.com 已在白名单内，无需改代码。 Unknown keys (such as this one) are ignored. Caps: 20 sections / 40 lines / 200 chars per line (segment text included) / 4000 chars in total — the rest is truncated, and a long body scrolls inside the dialog. The client fetches this file at runtime from the root-relative /data/notice.json with cache:'no-cache', so republishing THIS FILE ALONE is the update path: players see the new text on their next open, with no client rebuild, no server route and no restart. Any failure (404, offline, invalid JSON) falls back to the built-in text in notice.js NOTICE_FALLBACK.
title: 服务器公告

sections.label: 维护提醒
lines: 即将进行一次闪断更新（约 1 分钟）
更新期间正在进行的对局会被中断，非常抱歉，敬请谅解
更新后：同盟对局与房间在闪断后可恢复；正在战斗、抽卡、决战中的对局仍需重开

sections.label: 服务说明
lines: 本站为纯公益的非官方同人站点，与游戏官方及其关联方无关
可能会不定期重启更新版本等　对此造成的游戏中断致歉
闪断不丢掉游戏进度的功能将随本次更新上线：同盟对局与房间都能在闪断后回来

lines: 如遇服务器方面的问题，可以通过B站私信或发送邮件联系。
